digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure — subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted uses production-scale 10-second low-speed window and 15-second loopback server, causing 15+ second test runtime while contract requires only verifying sustained bytes survive one complete configured window

test_read_retried_then_terminal uses production-scale 1-second call timeout plus real 2s/4s retry sleeps across three child processes, consuming ~9 seconds per run while contract requires only verifying exactly three attempts and correct retry schedule

injecting sub-second trigger windows (1s stall, 0.1s call/grace/drain) into existing test fixtures while retaining real socket/process execution and cleanup polling will reduce test wall time to low single digits without compromising coverage or semantic assertions
production defaults for timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt count, and backoff values must remain unchanged
ACLI subprocess test must record every launched PID and poll until all are absent after terminal failure, proving no orphaned child or process group survives
